parties:
Chittagong Textile Mills Ltd. ----- Petitioner.
Vs.
Chairman, Labour Court, Chittagong and another ----- Respondents.
full_judgment: "In substance, this order directed that (1) the appellant be dismissed, (2) the dismissal to operate retrospectively as from May, 20, 1949. The two parts of this Composite order are separable. The first part of the order operates as a dismissal of the applicant as from October 17, 1950. The invalidity of the second part of the order, assuming this part to be invalid, does not affect the first part of the order. The order of dismissal as from October 17, 1950 is valid and effective. The appellant has been lawfully dismissed, and he is not entitled to claim that he is still in service."
